relationship_to_original_e5.estimand: relative diel effective observation distortion, not absolute detection probability

outcome_exposure_status.consequence: the empirical analysis may be called a prospectively frozen reanalysis after qualitative publication exposure, but not untouched preregistered validation; no model, threshold, geography direction or metric may be selected from empirical values

forbidden_inputs: any derived output containing camera-vs-GPS outcome direction

time_standardization.rule: apply the source study's sun-time transformation to both channels before diel estimation

gps_activity_anchor.sequence_rule: sort fixes within individual by Fix_DateTime
gps_activity_anchor.interval_rule_minutes: strictly >19 and <41, matching the public source code
gps_activity_anchor.movement_rate: Euclidean distance between successive X/Y fixes divided by elapsed hours, rounded to nearest meter/hour as in source code
gps_activity_anchor.pseudo_event_rule: for each accepted interval, generate N=rounded movement_rate pseudo-times uniformly within that interval, matching the public source algorithm
gps_activity_anchor.random_seed_rule: derive a deterministic 31-bit seed from SHA256(source_commit + geography + season); no empirical tuning
gps_activity_anchor.individual_weighting: construct one circular density per individual, normalize each to unit sum, then average individuals equally

camera_channel.event_independence: use released analysis-ready detections; do not alter the source study's >30 min independence preprocessing

circular_density.implementation_rule: use the source study overlap::densityPlot convention on the sun-time scale
circular_density.duplicate_midnight_endpoint_rule: drop final duplicate endpoint, leaving 255 bins
circular_density.normalization: normalize each resulting vector to sum 1

distortion_estimation.comparison_shape: renormalize exp(logD) to sum 1 only for shape-overlap calculations

transfer_design.rule: symmetric two-direction geographic holdout; no single geography is privileged

uncertainty.random_seed_rule: derive deterministic seeds from SHA256(contract_id + replicate_index)

interpretation_rule.supported: 95% bootstrap CI for median transfer gain is entirely > 0
interpretation_rule.unresolved: 95% bootstrap CI for median transfer gain includes 0
interpretation_rule.contradicted: 95% bootstrap CI for median transfer gain is entirely < 0
